mapper.select: SELECT CASE s.gender WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' WHEN 3 THEN '未知' END AS name, COUNT(s.id) AS value FROM exam_student s WHERE s.status = #{status} GROUP BY s.gender
SELECT CASE c.difficulty_level WHEN 1 THEN '基础' WHEN 2 THEN '提升' WHEN 3 THEN '拔高' END AS name, COUNT(c.id) AS value FROM exam_course c WHERE c.status = #{status} GROUP BY c.difficulty_level

SELECT CASE q.question_type WHEN 1 THEN '单选题' WHEN 2 THEN '多选题' WHEN 3 THEN '判断题' WHEN 4 THEN '填空题' WHEN 5 THEN '简答题' END AS name, COUNT(q.id) AS value FROM exam_question q WHERE q.status = #{status} GROUP BY q.question_type

SELECT CASE p.practice_type WHEN 1 THEN '日常刷题' WHEN 2 THEN '模拟考试' WHEN 3 THEN '错题重刷' WHEN 4 THEN '计划复习' END AS name, COUNT(p.id) AS value FROM exam_question_practice_record p WHERE p.answer_time >= #{startTime} AND p.answer_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY p.practice_type
SELECT CASE r.status WHEN 0 THEN '已取消' WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' END AS name, COUNT(r.id) AS value FROM exam_review_plan r GROUP BY r.status

SELECT CASE p.difficulty_level WHEN 1 THEN '简单' WHEN 2 THEN '中等' WHEN 3 THEN '困难' END AS name, COUNT(p.id) AS value FROM exam_paper p WHERE p.paper_type = #{paperType} AND p.status = #{status} GROUP BY p.difficulty_level
